partnerDemo.description: This page is designed for potential partners, not artists. It separates current modules, pilot modules and future integrations so the opportunity is clear.

sections.label: Problem
sections.title: Manual intake creates metadata risk.
sections.description: Artists, labels and catalogue owners often submit incomplete credits, ownership data and release details across fragmented tools.

sections.label: Opportunities
sections.title: Every intake can become structured catalogue intelligence.
sections.description: A partner can turn submissions into searchable leads, release records, conflict signals and future CRM workflows.

sections.label: Acquisition flow
sections.title: Capture and qualify catalogue owners.
sections.description: Catalogue Health Check routes prospects through a structured assessment instead of loose messages.

sections.label: Release flow
sections.title: Standardize release submissions.
sections.description: Release intake can collect assets, metadata, credits and readiness signals before distribution review.

sections.label: Internal panel
sections.title: Review leads, gaps and pending actions.
sections.description: Internal dashboards can organize statuses, documents, notes and unresolved rights questions.

sections.label: White-label model
sections.title: Your brand can sit on top of the workflow.
sections.description: The interface can shift brand, colors and positioning while keeping the platform architecture underneath.

sections.label: Roadmap
sections.title: Integrate storage, CRM and distribution operations.
sections.description: Future integrations can connect Supabase, Cloudflare R2, WhatsApp notifications, contracts and external rights workflows.

sections.label: Collaboration options
sections.title: Build, license or operate together.
sections.description: The model can support a pilot, white-label deployment, shared-revenue operation or custom platform build.

sections.label: Pilot request
sections.title: Start with a focused pilot.
sections.description: A small catalogue intake flow can validate partner demand before investing in deeper automation.
